spans.s:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (लडति लडयति)
1 To frolic, to sport or dally.
2 To loll (the tongue.)
3 To use the tongue.
4 To stir with the tongue.
5 To stir, to agitate.
6 To pain.
r. 10th cl. (-लाडयति)
1 To nurse, to foster, to attend closely.
2 To shake.
3 To feel desire.
(औ इ) औलडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (लंडति लंडयति)
1 To shine.
2 To toss or throw up.
3 To speak.

m. (-ड्डः)
A wretch, a villain, a low or bad man.

n. (-कं)
A class of sweetmeats, or a sweetmeat; a sort of ball made with flour fried with oil or Ghee, and mixed with sugar and spices, and distinguished into different kinds, [] according to some slight varieties in its less essential ingredients; also read लड्डक.
